# A dartboard on a square backboard: the board a 16-sided disc 0.46 m across, 5 cm thick, its face
# textured (textures/dartboard.png); the backboard maroon, 0.62 m square. Generated by make_env.py.
# Up Z, front -Y, origin at the board's centre on the wall.
new
material new Board --base-color 1 1 1 --no-slot
material texture Board base-color textures/dartboard.png
material new Back --base-color 0.5020 0.0000 0.0941 --no-slot
material new Rim --base-color 0.0000 0.0000 0.0000 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Back --size 1 --location 0.0000 -0.0150 0.0000
scale 0.6200 0.0300 0.6200
apply --scale
material assign Back
select Back
active Back
mode edit
select face where "normal.y > 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
add mesh cylinder --name Disc --vertices 16 --radius 0.23 --depth 0.05 --location 0 -0.055 0
set rotation 90 0 0
apply --rotation
material assign Rim
select Disc
active Disc
mode edit
select face where "normal.y > 0.9"
delete only-faces
select face where "normal.y < -0.9"
material assign Board
uv project-from-view front --scale-to-bounds
mode object
select Back Disc
active Back
join
shade flat
export dart.glb
